title.zh: 半导体差异：掺杂会移动费米能级
title.en: Semiconductor differences: doping shifts the Fermi level

subtitle.zh: 电子亲和势 / 掺杂 / 表面态 / 能带弯曲
subtitle.en: Electron affinity / doping / surface states / band bending

heading.zh: 01 不同掺杂类型的能带图

body.zh: 掺杂会移动费米能级，从而改变表面功函数。n 型（施主掺杂）：E_F 上移，Φ 趋小；本征（未掺杂）；p 型（受主掺杂）：E_F 下移，Φ 趋大。图中标注真空能级 E_vac、电子亲和势 χ、导带 E_C、费米能级 E_F、价带 E_V。
body.en: Doping shifts the Fermi level and changes surface work function. For n-type donor doping, E_F rises and Φ tends to decrease; intrinsic material is undoped; for p-type acceptor doping, E_F falls and Φ tends to increase. Diagrams label E_vac, χ, E_C, E_F, and E_V.

heading.zh: 02 表面功函数的理想关系

body.zh: 理想、无表面态时，表面功函数由电子亲和势和费米能级位置决定：Φ_S = χ + (E_C − E_F)。这是理想表面下的能带关系。
body.en: For an ideal surface without surface states, work function is set by electron affinity and Fermi-level position: Φ_S = χ + (E_C − E_F). This is the ideal-surface band relationship.

body.zh: 表面态、固定电荷、原生氧化层和吸附物会引入能带弯曲、费米能级钉扎，改变实测功函数。表面态（能级密度）导致弯曲并可能钉扎 E_F；固定电荷引发空间电荷区；原生氧化层（SiO₂ 等）引入界面态和固定电荷，改变表面势垒；吸附分子（如 H₂O、O₂）带电或形成偶极，诱导弯曲。
body.en: Surface states, fixed charge, native oxide, and adsorbates introduce band bending and Fermi-level pinning, changing measured work function. Surface states may bend bands and pin E_F; fixed charge creates a space-charge region; native oxide such as SiO₂ introduces interface states and fixed charge, changing the surface barrier; adsorbates such as H₂O/O₂ carry charge or create dipoles that induce bending.

heading.zh: 04 核心判断与 05 常见误区

body.zh: 同一种半导体，也可能因掺杂与表面状态表现出不同功函数。误区：只按体掺杂判断表面功函数；把 KPFM 对比直接当作绝对材料常数。
body.en: The same semiconductor can exhibit different work functions because of doping and surface condition. Mistakes: predicting surface work function from bulk doping alone, or treating KPFM contrast as an absolute material constant.

body.zh: 多种手段结合，区分体掺杂与表面贡献：UPS/XPS 看表面能级与功函数；KPFM 看表面功函数分布；以已知掺杂类型与趋势为参考；对比表面处理前后（去除/钝化表面态），并复测。
body.en: Combine methods to distinguish bulk-doping and surface contributions: UPS/XPS for surface energy levels and work function; KPFM for spatial work-function distribution; known doping type/trend as a reference; before/after surface-treatment comparison (removing/passivating states), followed by repeat measurement.

body.zh: n 型趋低、p 型趋高是理想趋势，表面态和能带弯曲可能改变实测结果。
body.en: Lower work function for n-type and higher for p-type is an ideal trend; surface states and band bending may change measured results.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
